paths.title: Dry run over 12 catalog tool(s)
paths.rationale: Dry run: no LLM was used. One happy path that calls every catalog tool whose required arguments can be defaulted from its schema, in catalog order. Skipped because the description says they cost money/credits or are slow: plan_recipe, plan_from_text, plan_week.
